messages.content: Hi there, it’s really nice to meet you. How have you been feeling lately, in general? What's something you’ve been enjoying or looking forward to these days?

Honestly, I've been a bit down. I used to work in a kitchen, but I had to leave due to my condition. It’s hard to know what to do with myself now. I just go through the motions, watching TV or playing games. Nothing really gets me excited anymore.

That sounds tough, and I’m glad you’re letting me know. Have you been feeling more tired lately and has your sleep changed at all—like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or not feeling rested? And if you’re noticing it, has your outlook felt more pessimistic recently?

Yeah, I'm tired all the time. I used to be able to go for a walk without getting winded, but now I can barely make it to the fridge. I wake up in the middle of the night and can't get back to sleep. And yeah, that just makes me feel like I'm losing my grip.

That sounds really rough—thanks for sharing that. Have you been having more trouble concentrating or making even small decisions, and have you noticed changes in your appetite or in how hopeful you feel about things lately?

It’s all of it, really. I'll be trying to read a book and I'll just stare at the page. My mind goes blank. And food... I eat because I have to, but I don't really enjoy it. I used to love cooking, but now it just feels like a chore.

That sounds really tough, and thank you for sharing that with me. Have you been feeling more indecisive about everyday choices recently, and if so, does it tend to come with self-criticism or guilt afterwards?

Yeah, all the time. I'll be trying to decide what to wear, and I'll just stand there for 20 minutes. I feel like I've lost my mind. And then I beat myself up over it. I'm just... I'm just not in control anymore.
That sounds really tough to carry. Have you been crying more often than usual lately?
Yeah. I've been crying a lot. It's embarrassing, really. I used to be the one who could handle anything, but now I'm just... broken.

That sounds rough, and I appreciate you sharing how you’ve been feeling. When things feel heavy, have you noticed yourself getting more agitated or irritable, and if that happens, do you also find yourself being harsher with yourself or feeling guilty or worthless about small things?

Yeah, definitely. I get so frustrated with myself over stupid things. Like, I dropped a spoon and I just... I just slammed my hand on the counter. I didn't mean to, but I just... I'm just so angry with myself all the time.

That sounds heavy, and I appreciate you sharing that. Do you ever feel like you’re not worth much or that you’ve failed in some way? If yes, how often does that come up—daily, a few times a week—and how does it affect what you feel able to do?
All the time. I feel like I've let everyone down. My friends, my family... they all think I'm still the person I used to be. But I'm not. I'm just... this broken thing.
That sounds really heavy to carry, and I appreciate you telling me. How often does that guilt come up for you—daily, or more often?
It’s constant. I wake up with it, go to bed with it. I can't turn it off.

That sounds really heavy to carry, and I appreciate you sharing that. When those moments of self-dislike show up, how often do they come—daily or a few times a week—and do you notice what tends to trigger them, like a tough moment or comparing yourself to how you used to be?
It’s every day. Sometimes it’s just a look in the mirror, or hearing someone else’s story. I used to be the strong one, but now I'm just... I'm just this broken mess.

That makes sense, and I really appreciate you sharing that. Have you been feeling more pessimistic lately about things getting better, and does that tend to come with you being harder on yourself after small mistakes or with changes in appetite?
Yeah, definitely. I don't see a way out. I've tried everything, and nothing's working. So I just... I just shut down.

Thank you so much for sharing all of this with me today. I really appreciate your openness and the courage it takes to talk about what you’ve been through. Take gentle care of yourself, and know I’m here if you’d like to chat again in the future. Wishing you kindness and strength as you move forward.
